I farm wheat on this small rented plot of 0.16 hectares here in Oromia. Since the land is rented, I am careful about what I spend, but wheat needs some fertilizer to give a good harvest, so I will try to get some DAP and urea from the cooperative if it arrives in time. I cannot afford improved seed this year, so I will use the seed I saved from last harvest. I have no money for pesticide or irrigation, and my family and I will do most of the work ourselves with our ox-plough.
